capabilities: Export folders recursively as separate PDFs
Merge notes into one PDF with chapter ordering
Preview and customize page layout, theme, and fonts
Queue exports and automate them via CLI or URI
extras: Mobile exports require Obsidian to stay in the foreground; the README states the plugin was entirely made by Gemini models.
problem: Mobile users lack an on-device way to export notes and folders to PDF without desktop-only print APIs.
summary: Obsidian plugin that exports notes, folders, or merged note sets to PDF on mobile and desktop.
